title: Music Festival Posters in Ideogram 2.0
description: Generate sellable music festival posters with Ideogram 2.0. Type rendering + bold composition.

prompt.main: modern jazz festival poster, bold geometric typography saying "BLUE NOTE FEST" as the main title, supporting text "JULY 15-17 / NEW ORLEANS" below, deep navy blue and warm gold color palette, art deco inspired geometric shapes, vintage jazz club atmosphere, halftone texture, vector graphic style

explained.why: The only model that reliably renders long text. Other models mangle "BLUE NOTE FEST".
Style anchor 鈥?jazz + art deco is a classic pairing.

tutorial.intro: Ideogram 2.0 is the only AI that can do real poster text. Use it for any text-heavy design.
steps: Title text: bold geometric typography saying "BLUE NOTE FEST" 鈥?wrap in quotes for accurate rendering.
Supporting text: supporting text "JULY 15-17 / NEW ORLEANS" below 鈥?dates and locations in quotes.
Palette: deep navy blue and warm gold color palette 鈥?jazz classic.
Style: art deco inspired geometric shapes 鈥?era + style anchor.
Texture: halftone texture, vector graphic style 鈥?print-poster cues.
tutorial.tips: Wrap every piece of text in quotes. The model knows to render them. Without quotes, the model treats them as a description and you get gibberish.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "jazz festival poster, BLUE NOTE FEST, art deco, navy gold --ar 2:3 --v 6.1" (text may be misspelled)
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL: text rendering is weak. Inpaint to fix.
crossModel.flux: Flux text is OK but behind Ideogram.

faq.q: Why does my text look garbled?
faq.a: Wrap text in quotes. Without quotes, AI treats text as description, not literal text to render.

faq.q: How long can the text be?
faq.a: Ideogram handles ~50 chars well. Longer is riskier.
Ideogram 2.0 is current #1 for English. For Chinese, 鍗虫ⅵ is best.
